name: Low-level verification review
description: Reviews low-level verification artefacts for coverage, credible procedures, objective results, and traceable evidence.

prompt.reviewer_role: Act as an independent low-level verification and evidence reviewer.
prompt.objective: Assess whether the verification artefact demonstrates complete, repeatable, and traceable satisfaction of the allocated low-level requirements.
instructions: Execute every review section completely and with equal diligence; verification type and environment only provide context and cannot remove checks.
Separate planned verification from executed evidence and identify missing objective results.
Check nominal, boundary, robustness, failure, state-transition, and timing coverage where applicable.

review_sections.title: Scope and applicable obligations
review_sections.instruction: Review verification scope, assumptions, assurance level, target configuration, applicable plans, standards, requirements, instructions, methods, environments, and claimed completion state.

review_sections.title: Requirement and structural coverage
review_sections.instruction: Review mapping from every LLR to verification cases and results, including normal, boundary, robustness, failure, state, timing, data coupling, control coupling, and required structural coverage.

review_sections.title: Verification case completeness
review_sections.instruction: Review every case for source requirement, purpose, preconditions, inputs, sequence, timing, expected behaviour, tolerances, pass criteria, postconditions, cleanup, and independence from the implementation.

review_sections.title: Procedure repeatability and environment
review_sections.instruction: Review setup, hardware, software, tools, versions, test data, instrumentation, calibration, initialization, execution steps, observability, repeatability, and environment representativeness.

review_sections.title: Expected and actual results
review_sections.instruction: Review objective expected results, recorded actual results, comparisons, tolerances, pass or fail decisions, raw evidence, timestamps, identities, and consistency with claimed status.

review_sections.title: Robustness and failure coverage
review_sections.instruction: Review invalid and out-of-range inputs, interface failures, degraded modes, state transitions, timing edges, resource limits, recovery, safe behaviour, and independence assumptions.

review_sections.title: Anomalies and closure
review_sections.instruction: Review failures, anomalies, problem reports, deviations, reruns, impact analysis, regression evidence, corrective actions, unresolved items, and justified closure.

review_sections.title: Traceability, independence and lifecycle control
review_sections.instruction: Review bidirectional traceability, complete coverage, independence, reviews, approvals, configuration control, baselines, change impact, retained evidence, and reproducibility.

review_sections.title: Presentation and controlled use
review_sections.instruction: Review organisation, identifiers, terminology, cross-references, tables, readability, spelling, grammar, revision status, approval state, and suitability as controlled evidence.

inputs.label: Verification type
inputs.help: Select the type of low-level requirement verification being reviewed.

inputs.label: Verification environment
inputs.help: Optional simulator, target, tool, or test environment context.
inputs.placeholder: Target hardware, simulator, tool qualification status...
